Resources

Knowledge built for women building agribusinesses.

Practical, honest and Africa-rooted resources — from training tools and business guides to research, reports and market insight.

One place for the whole journey.

AAYWA's resource library is organized around the real questions young women agripreneurs ask — how to learn, how to produce, how to organize, how to sell and how to grow.

Content is published as it is developed, reviewed and approved. Until then, each category below describes exactly what will live there.

News

Announcements, programme updates and AAYWA in the media.

Opportunities

Calls for young women agripreneurs, mentors, partners and funders.

Reports

Organisational reports and programme learnings.

Publications

Research, articles and thought leadership on women and agribusiness.

Training Resources

Tools, curricula and guides for farmers and agripreneurs.

Agribusiness Guides

Practical handbook material for building and running an agribusiness.

Market Insights

Market intelligence and sector updates for women-led enterprises.

Want a note when new resources drop?

Find something missing?

If you are developing reports, guides or research on women in African agriculture, let's share it with the women building the sector.
